request.prompt:
Create exactly ONE isolated full-body production prototype for Mass Effect — Armax Relay Clash, faithfully reproducing the specific original game model shown in the attached reference images. Realistic game-render finish, crisp silhouette, even neutral illumination, exact material colors and original proportions. Preserve all original side-specific features. One subject and one view only, not a montage or multi-view sheet. Keep the complete silhouette and every extremity inside the canvas with generous transparent margin on all sides. Transparent RGBA background, no environment, floor plane or cast floor shadow, no text or publisher marks. No redesigned details, extra equipment or new body parts. Static image only.

Subject: standard Remnant Architect from Mass Effect: Andromeda. The FIRST reference is the exact deployed pose and camera to follow; the SECOND clarifies the complete extended segmented construction of this same machine. Reproduce the first pose closely, showing the enormous dark gunmetal articulated Remnant structure with its angular scale-like armor plates, red emissive recessed grilles and narrow lights, broad three-part mechanical head with glowing red inner panels, and curved segmented supports. Preserve all structural branches and their original attachment points as seen in the first image. Show the full deployed machine in a landscape composition, scaling it DOWN enough that every outer support foot, rear segment, plate and head tip is comfortably inside the image. Do not add a human for scale, a base, a planet, arbitrary new appendages or additional weapons. The red light is confined to the original mechanical emitters; no energy blast or surrounding aura.
